what_changed: FCC requires voice service providers to block calls using a reasonable do-not-originate list and to return SIP code 603+ when blocking on analytics (47 CFR 64.1200(k)(9) as shown in the diff); 64.1200(o) delayed.
rationale: Duties fall on voice service providers, not on callers; a lender's dialer would only receive a different SIP response code when blocked. Stage A: title, abstract, metadata and eCFR diff excerpt only; full text not read.
